title: California Dreamin' Balloon Adventures
specs: Flights at sunrise for calm air and dramatic scenic moments
Flight altitude around 1500 feet with views over vineyards and hills
Owner and pilot David Bradley has over 9,200 flight hours and is FAA-certified
Guests aged 7 and up are welcome
Maximum weight limit per person is 300 lbs
No backpacks, purses, heavy coats, open-toed shoes, drones, or large recording/photography equipment allowed on balloon
Can accommodate groups up to 75 people with multiple balloons

includes: Round-trip transport to the launch site
About an hour aloft over Temecula wine country at sunrise
gap: Exact meeting time not stated; it shifts with sunrise and is given at booking
blurb: Guests meet at Vindemia, a private estate winery, before being driven to the launch site. The flight lasts about an hour, floating over vineyards and low hills at around 1500 feet. The full experience lasts about three to three and a half hours including transport, inflation, flight, and a celebration toast after landing.
extraNote: Cancel at least 72 hours before flight for full refund · Cancellations due to weather come at no charge; reschedule or refund offered · Weather cancels roughly one in five flights; keep backup morning open · If flight cannot fly due to weather, full refund, reschedule, or gift voucher offered · Vindemia, a private estate winery in Temecula Wine Country · Year round, weather permitting
